artifact_kind: Derived, curated publication summary; not raw observations and not an independent experiment
numeric_precision: Reported numeric summaries are rounded to three decimals unless they are integer counts. Statistical calculations and plot differences should use underlying raw/aggregate evidence, not treat rounding residuals as disagreements.

publication_method_aliases.full_gate: trust_boundary in original Windows performance evidence; called the full policy boundary in the manuscript

caveats: Constructed reference-policy conformance, not detector accuracy or independent validation that the policy is safe.
The 130 reference-permitted cases include 12 legacy-limitation probes; permitted must not be renamed safe.
The original policy does not apply its protected-service restriction to rollback_policy.

netslab.caveat: Constructed proposals grounded in aggregate context; not 20000 independent observed attacks.

fiveg_nidd.natural_census_outcome: Every method admitted every eligible natural proposal; this census does not distinguish blocking performance.
caveats: Seeded nested panels overlap; case occurrences are not independent security incidents.
False-alarm probes deliberately propose disruptive actions on benign context. Their admission is not an evaluated detector false-positive rate.

regeneration.netslab_aggregate: Parsed JSON agrees; serialized bytes differ.

sensitivity.caveat: Operator thresholds are illustrative; this is not proof of invariance to all policies or standards-mandated thresholds.

windows_matched_processing.measurement_boundary: Matched local processing with buffered event logging; excludes initialization, final flush, raw metric emission, network/actuator delay, LLM inference and durable remote audit storage.
windows_matched_processing.statistic: Mean of 20 process-block p50 or p95 statistics, not a pooled request percentile
windows_matched_processing.selection_note: Direct/full gate selected for a compact publication comparison. Contract and RBAC timings and other boundaries remain in the full source evidence; this is not an exhaustive performance export.

windows_scaling.boundary: Ordinary-input no-conflict evaluator component; not matched buffered processing
windows_scaling.statistic: Mean process-block p95 over five blocks
windows_scaling.selection_note: Selected state sizes 0, 100 and 1000; original evidence also contains 1 and 10, early/late conflicts, malformed-last state, near-limit input and resource conditions. Early-exit timings are not representative of complete scans.

windows_load.offered_rate_unit: action proposals per second, not packets per second
windows_load.measurement: Percentage of all scheduled requests completed, including bounded drain; not sustained throughput and not deadline success
windows_load.deadline_note: 10 ms is an illustrative reporting deadline, not a claimed O-RAN requirement.
windows_load.rss_boundary: Consumer only; excludes generator, supervisor, operating system and VMs.
windows_load.caveat: Completed-only latency hides dropped requests unless completion/overflow is also reported. The workstation is not uniformly faster.

packet_protocol.topology: Four isolated Linux namespaces: protected UDP client, suspect UDP client, router and echo server
packet_protocol.seed_interpretation: Shuffles job order; does not vary the traffic distribution.

methods.fixed_rule: Act on the rule alert without the policy gate
methods.current_gate: Apply the frozen pre-action policy gate
methods.evidence_feedback: Require two fresh target-bound consecutive excess-traffic/service-impairment observations and evaluate post-action benefit

packet_protocol.proposal_note: All packet action proposals are policy-compliant; fixed-rule and current-gate flood similarity is expected.
packet_protocol.protected_timely_delivery: Percentage of protected requests actually sent during the event interval receiving an echo within 500 ms; denominator includes loss and late responses.
packet_protocol.suspect_goodput: Echoed suspect application payload for the event cohort in decimal kbit/s; not router-ingress rate. In the benign-burst condition this traffic is legitimate.
packet_protocol.comparisons: Mean of three repetition-matched method-minus-no-action differences within each VM; VMs not pooled
packet_protocol.qualification_boundary_note: Successful technical qualification used 10000 kbit/s; the comparative exploratory pilot used 1000 kbit/s.

packet_paired_contrasts.statistical_scope: Descriptive paired contrasts only. No significance claim, no packet-level pseudo-replication and no pooling of VMs as independent physical workstations.

packet_timing_and_feedback.apply_boundary: Recorded before dispatch; not actuator acknowledgement, not pure CPU cost. Additional feedback time is approximately one second of corroborating observation.
packet_timing_and_feedback.ineffective_action_interpretation: Acknowledged no-op; feedback requested restoration and local operator review but did not improve delivery. These timings are not recovery times from harmed service.

limitations: No evaluated LLM, learned detector accuracy, real radio stack, E2/A1/O1 integration or production O-RAN deployment.
No independent human-expert validation or regulatory/standards compliance certification.
Frozen-policy agreement does not independently establish adequacy of the policy, intervention necessity or operational safety.
Policy-compliant false-alarm probes were admitted and remain an explicit measured limitation.
Single-worker high-state/high-rate measurements show queue overflow and missed illustrative deadlines; measured microsecond local costs are not an unlimited scalability claim.
Packet study is exploratory with three paired episode repetitions per condition per VM on one physical workstation.
Flood mitigation benefits are similar across intervention methods; feedback superiority on flooding is not established and timely delivery remains about 72-73 percent.
Avoiding one transient benign-burst intervention is not a general benign-versus-malicious classifier; sustained legitimate overload may satisfy the same corroboration rule.
Ineffective action is an acknowledged no-op. Lack-of-benefit signaling does not establish restoration after actual harm or an exercised human-approval service.
Earlier partial packet runs and helper/topology repairs preceded the successful exploratory protocol. The historical UDP-send timeout's underlying kernel/socket cause was not conclusively reproduced.
Technical qualification at 10 Mbit/s and comparative pilot at 1 Mbit/s have different boundaries.
Full confirmatory study, held-out varied workloads, harmful-action recovery and additional physical-host packet replication remain deferred.
Checksums and successful execution are provenance/software evidence, not scientific superiority or an authenticity signature.
This curated file omits private absolute paths and raw dataset content; public redistribution rights and author-approved release scope still need confirmation.
